subject: Request: One-time accelerator credits + 30d sandbox extension for Platinum Health
messages:
From: Alex Ford <aford@platinumhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask — additional sandbox time & credits

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We kicked off an internal integration test and ran into an ID token issue that delayed workload validation by ~10 days. The dev team expects to be back on track by next week but that pushes our evaluation window close to the end of our sandbox credits.

Two asks: can Redwood extend the sandbox by 30 days and provide a one-time uplift of credits so we can finish a full end-to-end evaluation (including embedding + reranking load tests)? We’re very close to a procurement approval — CFO is reviewing the final T&Cs — and I think a small accommodation now gets us to a signed contract in Q1.

I can share the internal usage snapshot and schedule a short call if helpful.

Cheers,
Alex
VP Product, Platinum Health

Attachment: platinum_usage_snapshot.csv (CSV, 42 KB)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ford <aford@platinumhealth.com>
Cc: Emily Ross <emily@platinumhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — additional sandbox time & credits

Alex — thanks for the note and for the usage snapshot. Appreciate the context; congrats on how fast the integration team moved despite the token hiccup.

Short answer: we can consider a one-time accelerator grant + 30d sandbox extension, but I need to secure approval from Deal Desk / Sales Ops for credits beyond the standard PLG cap and a one-off concession on contract timing. To make the case I’m putting together:

- precise ask (tokens + extension)
- clear success criteria to avoid open-ended allocations
- repayment/convert rules (credits convert to discounted committed capacity on close)
- impact to forecast and precedent notes

Proposed ask (draft for approval):
- 200k token credit grant (one-time)
- 30 calendar day sandbox extension
- 10% first-year usage discount if they sign a 12-month commit within 60 days of POC close

I’ve attached a short SOW outline and their usage snapshot. Jordan / Laura / Aditya — can you weigh in on risk/approval matrix and whether the numbers above are reasonable? If we get quick approval I’ll reply to Alex and loop in Finance + Legal to lock the convert terms.

Thanks —
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0123

Attachments: sow_outline_v2.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — additional sandbox time & credits

Chloe — thanks for pulling this together. A few quick data points from Sales Ops:

- Standard PLG cap is 100k tokens and a single 14-day extension for sandbox trial. Anything above requires Deal Desk approval.
- Historical conversion rate when we provide >150k credits is ~28% within 90 days; >200k moves conversion to ~31% but also increases cost exposure.

Given Platinum Health’s ARR potential (they’re targeting a 3-region rollout with estimated $180k ARR yr1), I’m comfortable recommending a conditional 150k token grant + 30d extension instead of 200k, with the 10% discount contingent on a 12-month commit and inclusion of a minimum monthly usage threshold in the contract. Also suggest requiring a brief success checklist signed by the prospect at the end of the POC (embedding throughput + latency targets).

If Laura says legal/finance are comfortable with the convert mechanics I can route this to Deal Desk for an expedited sign-off.

-Jordan
Director, Sales Operations
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask — additional sandbox time & credits

Team — Finance/Legal quick take: we can approve a one-time 150k token grant + 30d sandbox extension with the following guardrails:

- Credits expire if no purchase decision within 90 days after extension end.
- If they sign a paid contract within 60 days, unused credits are applied as a one-time credit on the first invoice (no cash refunds).
- Require countersignature on a short acceptance form outlining success criteria and responsible owners.
- Limit to one account (no multi-account split) and require confirmation of identity (CIF) from procurement.

Aditya — please prepare the short acceptance form and a revenue impact note for the Deal Desk packet (one-pager). Jordan — once you have the revenue math I’ll mark legal clearance and we can fast-track.

-Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quick ask — additional sandbox time & credits

Alex — good news. We’ve approved a conditional grant to help you finish the end-to-end tests:

What we’re providing (one-time, conditional):
- 150,000 token credit grant
- 30 calendar day sandbox extension starting Nov 18, 2026
- 10% first-year usage discount if Platinum Health signs a 12-month committed agreement within 60 days of the extended POC close

Conditions:
- Acceptance form with success checklist signed by your technical lead by the end of the extension
- Credits expire if no contract signature within 90 days after extension end; unused credits will be applied as a one-time invoice credit if they sign within 60 days
- Single account usage only; procurement must provide CIF before granting access

Next steps: I’ll send the acceptance form and a short addendum for signature (DocuSign). Jordan will include the revenue impact in the Deal Desk packet and Laura will provide the legal wording for convert mechanics. If this looks good I’ll enable the credits once we have the signed acceptance form.

If you want to jump on a 20-minute call today to walk the acceptance checklist I’m available 4-5pm PT.

Looking forward —
Chloe
